description: K₃NaSn₃Se₈ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nbm space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight Se atoms. There are four shorter (3.41 Å) and four longer (3.55 Å) K-Se bond lengths. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight equivalent Se atoms. All K-Se bond lengths are 3.68 Å. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Se atoms. All Na-Se bond lengths are 2.96 Å. There are two inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded to four Se atoms to form distorted edge-sharing SnSe₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.53 Å) and two longer (2.66 Å) Sn-Se bond lengths. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded to four equivalent Se atoms to form edge-sharing SnSe₄ tetrahedra. All Sn-Se bond lengths are 2.59 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to two equivalent K and two Sn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeK₂Sn₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Sn atom.
